query: Should we try retrieval-aware conditioning for promoter expression prediction?

candidates.title: TabR: Tabular Deep Learning Meets Nearest Neighbors in 2023
candidates.claim: TabR presents a retrieval-augmented tabular deep learning model that retrieves nearest neighbors from the training data to improve prediction.
candidates.risk: Neighbor retrieval must be constrained to the training side of chromosome-aware and gene-level splits before transfer to promoter expression prediction.

query: Should we try graph transfer for promoter expression prediction?

candidates.title: Chromatin interaction-aware gene regulatory modeling with graph attention networks
candidates.claim: GraphReg uses graph attention networks and 3D chromatin interactions to model distal regulatory effects on gene expression.
candidates.risk: Graph construction and interaction-source quality may dominate observed gains; start with diagnostic ablations before promotion.

query: Should we try ranking contrastive representation learning for promoter expression prediction?

candidates.title: Rank-N-Contrast: Learning Continuous Representations for Regression
candidates.claim: Rank-N-Contrast learns regression-aware continuous representations by contrasting samples according to their target-space rankings.
candidates.risk: Transfer depends on reliable target ordering and carefully controlled positive/negative construction for gene expression labels.
